method: Static checks by reading the concept's own source plus private headless Playwright Chromium (javaScriptEnabled) over http://127.0.0.1:8899 against the real shared modules; 21/21 live checks pass, zero page errors.

static_checks.check: virtualization present: PMManagers2.virtualList on #/all with rowHeight 64; host [data-test=vlist] updates data-window start:end:total via onWindow
no scope selectors (Global/Project/Goal/Host), no inheritance, no profiles/sync UI
no emoji; icons only via PMIcons
retheme prohibitions honored: no terminal green hex, no CRT, no fake shell; body uses var(--font-ui); var(--font-mono) only for path/log/code-ish microcopy
reduced motion: [data-reduced-motion=1] kills drill-in animation and shared skeletons/spinners (pm-shell.css + concept CSS)
search rows carry data-rid and .pm2-r-title; routing via PMSearch2.byRid only; #/q/<query> pushed before target

test hooks present: data-test=search-input/search-results/back/close/home/all/copy/vlist, data-route on root view (hash minus #), data-manager on manager detail panes, data-manager-row on domain manager rows, pm2-locate on exact landing
keyboard-first: Ctrl+K palette overlay, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight drill between visible panes, Enter opens selection, Esc order popup→palette→detail→one level out→Home
narrow/squeezed: push navigation one pane at a time via .push-on; Back names previous level; selection/scroll preserved per route
transactional copy: source → categories → preview counts (add/replace/unchanged/unavailable/conflict) → typed COPY confirm → restore point → verify → rollback

live_checks.check: title 'Command Suite — Qwen 5.8'; #app mounts; data-route=/home; home/back/close/breadcrumb/search hooks present
search 'rate limit': rows carry data-rid and .pm2-r-title; grouped dropdown
select sr:object:claude-oauth.rate-limits routes to #/mgr/providers/claude-oauth?sec=limits; .pm2-locate applied; [data-manager=providers] present; back visible
browser Back: #/q/rate%20limit; input value 'rate limit' restored; dropdown reopened
synthetic toggle: data-window total 2828; real 828 never replaced
all 42 manager routes render [data-manager] + [data-test=back] + [data-test=breadcrumb] with correct data-route
Ctrl+K opens palette overlay; Esc closes it
zero page errors across the whole run

known_limitations: Manager-local fixture rows are demo values from PMManagers2Data, not inventory rows, by design.
Concept is a prototype; no canonical Plans/catalog changes.
